## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for every code change (SPEC §8.1); bug fixes start with a failing test
- [ ] `make coverage` and `make lint-content` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed command cards: command checked by hand, description explains what it does, danger level reviewed
